title: Representative normalization of fixed-coefficient tensor evaluation
statement: Let $W$, $B$, $\mathcal A$, $n$ and the exact level evaluation be as in the tensor-evaluation data definition [def-coef-etale-system-tensor-evaluation]. Define normalized tensor evaluation to be such data with the following additional representative square. For every pair of K-flat cochain complexes $P,Q$ in the actual strict-system module category, compose the inverse derived tensor-evaluation isomorphism with evaluation of the inverse K-flat total-tensor model isomorphism. This equals the composite of the two exact-evaluation localization comparisons, the canonical lax tensor map for localization to the fixed-ring derived category, localization of the recorded total-complex comparison map, and the inverse localization comparison on the total tensor. Use the actual K-flat tensor models and quasi-isomorphism localization [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Thus the derived map is fixed before evaluation on representatives, without choosing a new tensor operation or assuming boundedness.
